environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Linux, B1 tier) behind Azure Front Door with default caching profile. No additional response header policies configured on the CDN or reverse proxy layer. Application is accessed directly via the App Service URL (*.azurewebsites.net). No Content-Security-Policy headers are set at any layer. Health check probes hit /api/widget?theme=default&locale=en every 30 seconds.

config.cdn: Azure Front Door (default profile, no custom rules)
